source_intent.summary: Research X and shape follow-up work.

research_provenance.summary: Research output remains latent until accepted or promoted.
Natural-language research request produced a candidate decision package.

research_evidence.claim: A research result can carry enough detail for later issue shaping.
research_evidence.support: The contract keeps objectives, constraints, assumptions, objections, and stop conditions together before promotion.

research_evidence.claim: A latent contract is not execution authority.
research_evidence.support: The status remains draft_latent and promotion metadata is absent.

accepted_objectives: Define the runtime-facing Decision Contract model.
Preserve private runtime evidence as the source of truth while exposing only sparse public projection references.
non_goals: Do not expose graph mechanics as the user workflow.
constraints: Store contract payloads in local runtime SQLite.
Keep Linear as a coarse public mirror.
assumptions: Future issue-shaping code can consume the accepted contract without asking the user to restate all details.
objections: Promotion must fail when required acceptance criteria are missing.
stop_conditions: Request human decision when unresolved direction affects acceptance criteria.
Reject or supersede a contract when later evidence invalidates it.

execution_readiness.summary: Ready for issue shaping after acceptance; latent status prevents queueing until promotion.
risk_notes: Do not infer execution authority from research provenance alone.

public_projection_refs.summary: Public issue briefing names the research-to-execution handoff without containing private loop evidence.
